We went to Atmosphere 360 on our honeymoon. Safe to say, you do not go here for the food. Everything was cold, even the tea and coffee and there was v little choice at the buffet. We weren't offered any other drink apart from tap water and we only got one glass as we arrived. Definitely do not cone here if you want a good afternoon tea experience.The view was amazing and afternoon tea is much cheaper here than dinner so it was a good price to spend an hour soaking up the KL panorama.
